steps.en: Staff opens a notice and its evidence files are loaded
steps.id: Staff membuka notice dan file bukti ikut dimuat

steps.en: Photos and videos appear in separate lists per notice
steps.id: Foto dan video tampil di daftar terpisah per notice

steps.en: Photo evidence is kept in its original format and quality
steps.id: Foto bukti disimpan dengan format dan kualitas aslinya

steps.en: Video evidence is available for the notice
steps.why_en: Videos arrive only from staff uploads or stay on an external system; photo-style automatic intake does not cover video.
steps.why_id: Video hanya masuk dari upload staff atau tetap di sistem luar; intake otomatis seperti foto tidak mencakup video.

steps.en: Staff can see the photo on screen and watch the video
steps.id: Staff bisa melihat foto di layar dan memutar video
steps.why_en: Photos open in a preview window, but there is no video player; videos can only be saved.
steps.why_id: Foto terbuka di jendela preview, tetapi tidak ada pemutar video; video hanya bisa disimpan.

steps.en: Staff downloads one evidence file in its original format
steps.id: Staff mengunduh satu file bukti dalam format aslinya

steps.en: Staff downloads all photos or videos of a notice as one zip
steps.id: Staff mengunduh semua foto atau video notice sebagai satu zip
